description: Ministry of Labour, Trade Union Relations - Notify the wages Board for the Textile Manufacturing Trade
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the approval and implementation of decisions made by the Wages Board for the Textile Manufacturing Trade under the Wages Boards Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory matter involving the establishment of wage classifications and employment standards for a specific industry, falling squarely under the "Legal/Regulatory" category (Type 5) for statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks.
